tasks.subject: Task 1: Pure Date-String Helpers
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add small, independently-tested pure functions for date validation, adjacency, future-checking, and relative labeling — the logic both `DateNav` and the page-level guard depend on.

**Files:**
- Create: `lib/utils/log-date.ts`
- Test: `lib/utils/log-date.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `isValidLogDate` returns `true` only for well-formed, real `yyyy-MM-dd` calendar dates
- [ ] `isFutureLogDate` correctly compares two `yyyy-MM-dd` strings
- [ ] `adjacentLogDate` correctly steps a date forward/back across month and year boundaries
- [ ] `logDateLabel` returns `'Today'`, `'Yesterday'`, or a formatted label (`'EEE, d MMM'`) for any other date

**Verify:** `npx vitest run lib/utils/log-date.test.ts` → all tests pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/utils/log-date.ts", "lib/utils/log-date.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run lib/utils/log-date.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["isValidLogDate returns true only for well-formed real yyyy-MM-dd dates", "isFutureLogDate correctly compares two yyyy-MM-dd strings", "adjacentLogDate steps across month/year boundaries", "logDateLabel returns Today/Yesterday/formatted label"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: useLoggedDatesInMonth Query Hook
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add a TanStack Query hook that fetches which dates within a given month have a saved `daily_logs` entry, returned as a `Set<string>` for fast dot-marker lookups in the calendar.

**Files:**
- Modify: `lib/queries/daily-logs.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `useLoggedDatesInMonth(monthStart)` queries `daily_logs` for dates within `[monthStart, monthEnd]` inclusive
- [ ] Returns a `Set<string>` of `'yyyy-MM-dd'` date strings
- [ ] Caches per-month via a `['daily-logs', 'logged-dates', monthStart]` query key, matching the existing convention used by `useWeightHistory`

**Verify:** `npm run build` → compiles with no TypeScript errors (no dedicated unit test — thin Supabase query wrapper, consistent with existing untested query hooks)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/queries/daily-logs.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["useLoggedDatesInMonth queries daily_logs within month range", "returns a Set<string> of yyyy-MM-dd strings", "uses query key ['daily-logs','logged-dates', monthStart]"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: DateNav Header Bar + Page-Level Date Guard
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace the static `

{date}

` in `LogForm` with a `DateNav` header providing prev/next-day navigation, a relative date label, and a "Today" shortcut — and add server-side validation so malformed or future date URLs redirect to `/log` instead of crashing the page. **Files:** - Create: `components/log/date-nav.tsx` - Modify: `app/(app)/log/[date]/page.tsx` - Modify: `components/log/log-form.tsx:134` **Acceptance Criteria:** - [ ] Tapping the back arrow navigates to the previous day's `/log/[date]` - [ ] Tapping the forward arrow navigates to the next day, and is disabled when the next day would be in the future - [ ] The date label shows "Today", "Yesterday", or `'EEE, d MMM'` for other dates - [ ] A "Today" pill appears only when viewing a non-today date, and navigates to today when tapped - [ ] Visiting `/log/not-a-date` or `/log/2099-01-01` redirects to `/log` (which redirects to today) **Verify:** Manual smoke test — `npm run dev`, visit `/log`, use the arrows and Today pill to move between several days, then visit `/log/bogus-date` and `/log/2099-01-01` directly and confirm both redirect to today's log ```json:metadata {"files": ["components/log/date-nav.tsx", "app/(app)/log/[date]/page.tsx", "components/log/log-form.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run dev", "acceptanceCriteria": ["back/next arrows navigate adjacent days", "forward arrow disabled at today", "date label shows Today/Yesterday/formatted label", "Today pill shown only on non-today dates", "invalid and future date URLs redirect to today"]} ```

tasks.subject: Task 4: DayCalendarSheet Calendar Popup
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make the date label in `DateNav` open a month-grid calendar popup (custom-built, styled to match the app's dark/emerald theme) that marks days with saved entries and lets the user jump straight to any past date.

**Files:**
- Create: `components/log/day-calendar-sheet.tsx`
- Modify: `components/log/date-nav.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Tapping the date label opens a calendar sheet showing the month of the currently-viewed date
- [ ] Days with a saved `daily_logs` entry show a small accent-colored dot
- [ ] Today is ringed, the currently-viewed date has a filled accent background
- [ ] Future dates are dimmed and not selectable
- [ ] Tapping a valid date navigates to `/log/[that-date]` and closes the sheet
- [ ] Prev/next month arrows browse the calendar without navigating the page
- [ ] Backdrop click or the close button dismisses the sheet without navigating

**Verify:** Manual smoke test — `npm run dev`, open the calendar from `/log`, browse months, confirm dot markers appear only on days you've actually logged, select a past date and confirm it navigates there, and confirm future dates can't be selected

```json:metadata
{"files": ["components/log/day-calendar-sheet.tsx", "components/log/date-nav.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run dev", "acceptanceCriteria": ["calendar opens on the viewed date's month", "logged days show accent dot", "today ringed and viewed date highlighted", "future dates dimmed and unselectable", "selecting a date navigates and closes sheet", "month arrows browse without navigating", "backdrop/close dismiss without navigating"]}
```
